doc.title: Wycliffe Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001

title: Playing the trombone vocally
summary: He tries to play in a vocal, singing way rather than technically, which is what he thinks the instrument is for.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing

blocks.x: the way people talk from time to time. I think about the way that people laugh from time to time. So when I go to play I don’t try to play the note that fit in this chord or the scale that — I try not to make it technical but more vocal, which is what I figure that the instrument is truly for.
